title: I will say that...
text: I will say that apparently many people think they are getting a tour of the Dalí museum with this experience, me included. The way it is titled and written is misleading. However, if you ready all the details you will see that you don’t get a guide in the museum or tickets to the museum. So that was disappointing to me. However, that being said, our driver Adair was great! He was very informative during the ride and the stop to Girona was an unexpected delight! What a charming town!
author: debbieguth
